title: Filer High CPU
body:
Hi Chris, thanks for all the effort you've put into creating seaweefs.

I'm having an issue with the Filer during a long run. I'm attempting to load 100 million compressed BLOBs (~30-40K each) into a single Volume server via the Filer API.

I have 16 concurrent client processes which are sending a combined load of about 10,000 BLOB's per minute (165/second). So the load is pretty low.

Everything runs fine for several hours with low CPU. I see CPU usage on the Filer of about 10%. Sometimes it spikes to 20-30% but not for long. But after the first 6 hours with 10 million BLOBs the CPU sits on a constant 110-140% under top (depending on how many clients I have running). 

When I pause the clients the Filer CPU immediately drops to 0%. I'm not seeing much CPU used by the Volume process even when the Filer is under full load.

If I debug the client and step through a single upload, I can see on the server the CPU spikes to >10%. And then quickly maxes out if I just let it run.


Is the CPU load I'm seeing normal? This is the first time I've used Filer, usually just Volume server. Filer is not really usable with such high CPU.


For my Filer keys I'm using real wold URLs. So the keys are pretty long with quite a few paths. And the keys will have lots of "files" per "directory". Will this slow things down?

Is there anything you can suggest that might be the problem? Do longer keys or many files require a lot more CPU? My BLOB's are VERY compressed already using a non-standard algorithm, is seaweedfs trying to re-compress these?

I don't really know how to debug GO and I'm not a linux expert so I'm not sure how much more info I can provide.





**System Setup**
All nodes running FreeBSD 11,2-RELEASE. Disks are ZFS RAIDz2 (non production). Low-spec modern hardware, dual core.

2 Volume servers but Filer collection is on one Volume server only. 

Filer is running on same node as the Volume server that contains the target collection. Almost no CPU usage for the Volume server.

Master server running on other node, no CPU load.

Clients are running from a Windows box using a custom C# client. Basic REST commands.



**Expected behavior**
Long run expected to continue to use modest CPU as number of files grow.
